in_marathi.name: Urvi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Urvi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Urvi means 'river'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Urvasi is known for her beauty and grace, often depicted as a river goddess.
